# Copilot CLI MCP event fixture

This is a hand-written, sanitized `events.jsonl` fixture. It contains no copied
user transcript, credentials, repository content, or live MCP output.

The shape follows the public session-event schema shipped with GitHub Copilot
CLI 1.0.77. Separate `mcpServerName` and `mcpToolName` fields on
`tool.execution_start` are supported from Copilot CLI 0.0.393 onward. Synthetic
records cover exact start/completion linkage, two servers exposing the same
tool name, success, error and contentless completions, interleaving, malformed
pairs, duplicate and conflicting starts, duplicate completions, sequential ID
reuse, late duplicate retraction, duplicate and escaped-equivalent attribution
keys, and orphans. A second sanitized session reuses a call ID to prove that
linkage scope remains session-local. Resource-bound and oversized-line cases
are generated by the focused tests so the checked-in fixture stays compact.
